data.display_address: The Crest Tower D, sobha_hartland, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover Caribbean-inspired waterfront living in The Crest Tower D by Sobha Realty, nestled in the heart of MBR City – Sobha Hartland. This brand-new apartment offers a full lagoon view, open layout, and elegant interiors with premium finishes. Perfectly positioned in a thriving community with world-class amenities, and just minutes from Downtown Dubai.

Ready to move | Ideal for end-users & investors

Property Features:

-1, 2 or 3 Bedrooms (Some with Maid’s Room)
-Full Lagoon & Open View
-Floor-to-ceiling windows
-Balcony with waterfront views
-Modern kitchen with quartz countertops
-Built-in wardrobes

Amenities:

-Infinity lagoon-facing pool
-Gym, spa, and yoga/spin/pilates studios
-Sky gardens & interconnected terraces
-Kids’ pool & play areas
-BBQ area, multipurpose hall, Tai Chi terrace
-24/7 security, concierge, covered parking
-Retail, cafés & supermarkets onsite

Location Highlights:

-1.1 km from Hartland International School
-10 mins to Downtown Dubai & Meydan
-Easy access to major highways

Company: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
